final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), status_shares AS (SELECT conservation_count, conservation_count * 1.0 / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT conservation_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT AVG(conservation_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
